text:
Maria: Heads up — noticed 8 A100s marked 'soft-reserved' in the vendor portal for our us-west2 pool but our infra quota CLI returns 8 available. UI/dashboard is showing 0 available. Anyone else seeing a mismatch? @Kevin @Toni :eyes:
Kevin: I saw a blip earlier. vendor portal lists reservations rsv-78f2 and rsv-78f3 with owner=marketplace:ml-partner. Might be trial holds.
Maria: Ran the check: `rctl quota get --region us-west2 --sku a100` -> available: 8. But console shows 0. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/shot123
vendor-bot: Reservation lookup: rsv-78f2 -> owner=marketplace:ml-partner, state=soft-reserved, expires=2026-03-23T12:00Z. rsv-78f3 -> similar. To cancel: `vendorctl cancel rsv-78f2` (requires partner-ops permission).
Sasha (oncall): If they're marketplace auto-holds we usually fallback to a different demo pool. I'll queue a routing patch to move the canary to `dedicated-demo-2` for the next 30m.
Toni (procurement): I'll ping partner ops. @Kevin can you share the account id to include in the ticket?
Kevin: account id = ac-987654. Opening partner ticket now. Ticket: https://vendor.ticket/INC-4812
Maria: Quick note — I put a 10m canary change to use `dedicated-demo-2` (rolled) so user-facing jobs aren't affected.
Kevin: Partner ops replied: automated trial holds for marketplace images; they can release on request or TTL. They asked for reservation ids + account id.
Toni (procurement): Sent release request with rsv-78f2,rsv-78f3 and ac-987654 (cced partner-ops@vendor).
vendor-bot: Partner ops acknowledged. ETA ~25m to release holds.
Sasha (oncall): Will keep canary on fallback pool until confirmation. If release happens earlier I'll flip routing back. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll draft a short runbook update (detecting mismatch + commands to cancel marketplace soft-reservations). Will post link here once done.
Kevin: Added preliminary steps to infra-runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-reservations
vendor-bot: reservations rsv-78f2,rsv-78f3 -> state changed to released (2026-03-23T11:48Z).
Maria: Confirmed in portal and via `rctl quota get` -> now shows available: 8 and dashboard synced.
Toni (procurement): Filing follow-up with partner to whitelist our dedicated pools or reduce auto-hold TTLs so this doesn't recur.
Maria: Thanks all — leaving this thread open until runbook link posted, then I'll close. :)
Kevin: Runbook link added with exact vendorctl commands and the partner ticket reference.
Maria: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-reservations#steps. Closing after 1h if no issues. :white_check_mark:
